note: Generated by scripts/export_data.py — do not edit by hand. Severity labels are this project's triage heuristics, as in the Python source.

13.name: Graphics Engine Exception
13.notes: Often application-level; NVIDIA classifies as non-fatal in the k8s DRA GPU health check defaults.

31.name: GPU memory page fault
31.notes: Memory page fault; can indicate app bug or HW issue.

45.name: Preemptive removal (application abort)
45.notes: Logged when the app aborts and the driver tears down the GPU context (Ctrl-C, GPU reset, sigkill). Usually NOT a bug — a user or system action. Ignore unless chained to other XIDs.

48.name: Double-bit ECC error (uncorrectable)
48.notes: Uncorrectable DRAM error; row-remap / service path per site policy.

62.name: PMU halt error
62.notes: Internal power-management microcontroller halted; catalog immediate action is GPU reset.

63.name: DRAM retirement (row remapping) event
63.notes: Informational: the GPU is handling ECC errors via row/page remapping. No response needed on its own.

64.name: DRAM retirement failure
64.notes: Row/page remapping failed — the GPU could not contain an ECC error. Catalog immediate action is GPU reset.

74.name: NVLink error
74.notes: NVLink fabric error; check bridges / switch per platform docs.

79.name: GPU has fallen off the bus
79.notes: GPU lost PCIe connectivity; commonly power/thermal/seating/HW.

92.name: Excessive single-bit ECC interrupts
92.notes: High single-bit ECC error rate. Often a precursor to uncorrectable (XID 48) errors — watch this GPU closely.

119.name: GSP RPC timeout
119.notes: GPU System Processor error; typically needs GPU reset per docs.

120.name: GSP error
120.notes: GPU System Processor error; typically needs GPU reset per docs.
